tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bdag bskyed 'chi med snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bdag bskyed mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis gsung rab las zur du bkol ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes gsum sogs ci nus/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang bcing gi steng nas mthe bong bkas pa'i phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ sku mdog dkar po rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu kha dkur bstan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo dpral bar bzhag ste/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sku dang / thal mo snying khar sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gsung dang /

rdo rje thal mo las gung mo gnyis dang / mtha' bzhi sbyar te brkyang pa'am/ bla ma phyi ma rnams rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo dang mtha' bzhi sbyar ba bzhed/ phyag rgya de nyid snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs la/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung brkyang ba phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa/ sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣīñca oṃ/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa/ dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣīñca traṃ/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor mnyam la/ lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba/ sdig pa sreg pa'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣīñca hrīḥ de g.yon du kha bsgyur ba/ las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon par bzhag la/ oṃ karmā a bhi ṣīñca āḥ zhes brjod cing gnas de rnams su mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yon grub pa rnams kyis dbur brgyan/ de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i smin mtshams nas/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar byas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta a yur puṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsa yaṃ ka ri ni swāhā/ sngags 'di las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar byas/ phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par gyur/

sngags ci nus bzlas so/ /gzhan yang / oṃ bh+rūṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa yang ci nus bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gong ltar/ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñca sogs kyis dbang bskur/ bh+ri ta sogs kyis byin rlabs brtan par byas/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur byas te/ mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas/ mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub byas la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na larka ma hā kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pa ya/ na sha ya na sha ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pra nān hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod la gnas gsum du gtugs pas bsrung ngo / /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas sogs/ lo brgya 'tsho zhing sogs bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis nyams len pa rnams la phan phyir bris pa lags/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bdag bskyed 'chi med snying po/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
